resources.string: PlayCube Task Manager: hold Home and Force stop

Hold Home or press the blue button to open PlayCube Task Manager. Spare remote buttons do what you set on the Buttons screen in PlayCube Task Manager: open an app, PlayCube Task Manager, Home, Back or Close all. When you close an app in PlayCube Task Manager, this presses Force stop and OK in that app\'s App info for you. It does nothing else.
